request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tweag by Modus Create's delivery of three Cardano core infrastructure work packages over 2026-2027.

claims.claim: The proposal requests ₳18,263,496.00, stated as USD $4,565,874.00, to fund three work packages across core Cardano infrastructure in 2026-2027.
The work packages are Peras v1, History Expiry, and Conformance Testing for Peras and Leios, and the proposer says they are interdependent as a single delivery pipeline.
Peras is claimed to improve finality to about two minutes versus about twelve minutes today.
History Expiry is claimed to reduce SPO storage costs by enabling partial-history nodes, with the document asserting Leios could otherwise drive disk usage to about 1 GB per hour at 100-1000 TPS.
The budget is said to be based on an average market rate of $176 per hour for senior Cardano infrastructure engineers and an ADA/USD conversion rate of 0.25 based on a five-year average.
Intersect is requested to serve as proposal, contract, audit, and delivery assurance administrator using milestone-based fixed-price contracts where scope is well-defined.
Technical deliverables are said to require review by IOG and independent validation by No Witness Labs as a third-party assessor across relevant work packages.

Funds are to be managed through Intersect treasury reserve and project-specific smart contracts, with stated multi-party authorization thresholds and an external oversight committee consisting of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, Xerberus, and NMKR for the 2025 TRSC.
The proposal states that all funds not disbursed by the end of the delivery period, and unspent funds tied to canceled or reduced deliverables, will be returned to the Cardano Treasury.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not, at submission, alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

summary: The document describes a ₳18,263,496 treasury request for Tweag-managed Cardano core infrastructure work across Peras v1, History Expiry, and Conformance Testing, with Intersect administration, smart-contract-based fund controls, milestone acceptance, public reporting commitments, and refund conditions, while leaving detailed budget, feasibility, alternatives, failure-mode, and community-impact analyses outside the supplied anchor text.
